summary: Iteration 11 — Tested 3 new features: 8 new Industry Add-Page layouts, working cart runtime (drawer + Stripe Checkout), and Social Buttons builder. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 6 new tests (TestCheckoutSession happy path + 4 validation 400s + payment-link >999999). Full pytest run: 50/50 passed (all previous 44 + 6 new). New endpoint POST /api/commerce/checkout-session returns real https://checkout.stripe.com/ session URL for valid carts and rejects empty items / missing name / zero / negative amounts with 400. Frontend Playwright (viewport 1920x1080, tour dismissed via localStorage): all 8 new Industry layout items present in Add Page modal with data-testids as spec'd (podcast, church, wedding, saas-changelog, realestate, clinic, nonprofit, conference); preview iframe rendered for each. Confirmed 3 inserts (podcast, wedding, clinic) each created a new page tab (1→2→3→4). Shop+WorkingCart page: added via add-page-item-shop-cart, then Preview mode mounted preview-iframe; floating #wdc-open button present; clicking a data-wd-add button opened #wdc-panel (class 'open'), #wdc-count went 1→2 via [data-inc], #wdc-total showed $38.00; clicking #wdc-checkout DID fire POST /api/commerce/checkout-session BUT the response was 502 (see rca). CommerceTab add-cart-btn inserted a canvas block (6→7) and add-atc-btn with name/price also inserted (7→8). Social Builder: modal opens; share↔follow toggle works; platform selects, shape/style/hover/size/gap/labels controls all respond; social-preview-iframe renders; social-insert in SHARE mode produces canvas element whose HTML contains data-wds-share=true; in FOLLOW mode with a URL entered into a social-url-* input, the inserted block contains that URL as href.

integration_issues.flow: Cart -> Stripe Checkout inside Preview iframe
integration_issues.issue: In the app's srcdoc Preview iframe, location.origin==='null' and location.pathname==='srcdoc' so cart.js POSTs origin_url='nullsrcdoc'. server.py concatenates this into success_url/cancel_url ('nullsrcdoc/?wd_checkout=success'), Stripe rejects the invalid URL, backend returns 502. Real exported/published sites will send a valid origin so this only breaks the in-app Preview demo. Two possible fixes: (a) in /app/frontend/src/lib/cart.js drop origin_url when location.origin==='null'; (b) in /app/backend/server.py validate origin_url looks like http(s):// and fall back to https://example.com otherwise. Recommend BOTH.

action_items: Harden /api/commerce/checkout-session: reject or sanitize non-http(s) origin_url values before building success_url/cancel_url so a bad client cannot cause a 502 from Stripe (return a clear 400 or fall back to a safe default).
In /app/frontend/src/lib/cart.js, when location.origin==='null' (srcdoc/sandbox), omit origin_url so backend uses its default; this fixes Preview-mode checkout hand-off.
critical_code_review_comments: cart.js line 109 builds origin_url from location.origin+location.pathname without guarding against 'null' origins (srcdoc, file://, sandboxed iframes). Guard with: var o=(location.origin&&location.origin!=='null')?(location.origin+location.pathname):''; and only include origin_url when non-empty.

server.py commerce_checkout_session should validate payload.origin_url with a simple URL parse (must start with http:// or https://) and coerce to a safe default otherwise, so a bad client input becomes a 4xx or is transparently corrected instead of surfacing as an opaque 502 from Stripe.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all UI flows work (layouts x8, add-cart-btn, add-atc-btn, social builder share+follow modes with data-wds-share and href verification, drawer open/qty/total). Only failure: in-Preview Stripe checkout returns 502 due to nullsrcdoc origin (root cause identified above).

seed_data_creation: Stripe test-mode Checkout Sessions + Price/PaymentLink objects were created in the claimable sandbox during backend tests. Test-mode only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview iframe is srcdoc — location.origin returns the string 'null'. Any runtime that posts to backend must guard for that. Testids for this iteration: page-add-btn, add-page-modal, add-page-cat-Industry, add-page-cat-Shop, add-page-item-<id> (industry-podcast/-church/-wedding/-realestate/-clinic/-nonprofit/-conference, saas-changelog, shop-cart), add-page-preview-iframe, add-page-confirm; left-tab-shop / left-tab-library; commerce-tab, add-cart-btn, atc-name, atc-price, add-atc-btn; open-social-builder, social-builder-modal, social-mode-share|follow, social-plat-<id>, social-shape/style/hover/size/gap/labels, social-url-<id>, social-preview-iframe, social-insert; mode-design/mode-preview, preview-iframe; runtime IDs #wdc-open, #wdc-panel (.open), #wdc-count, #wdc-total, #wdc-checkout, [data-wd-add], [data-inc]/[data-dec].
rca_of_the_issue: cart.js posts origin_url = location.origin + location.pathname. Inside the WebDojo Preview iframe (rendered via srcdoc), the browser reports location.origin='null' and location.pathname='srcdoc', yielding origin_url='nullsrcdoc'. server.py:_create_checkout_session then calls Stripe with success_url='nullsrcdoc/?wd_checkout=success' and cancel_url='nullsrcdoc/?wd_checkout=cancel'. Stripe rejects the non-URL, the exception is caught and re-raised as HTTP 502 'Stripe checkout failed'. Verified by capturing the request body: {"items":[{"name":"Aurora Bottle","amount":38,...}],"origin_url":"nullsrcdoc"} -> 502 Bad Gateway from backend. Same endpoint returns 200 with a real checkout.stripe.com URL when origin_url='https://example.com' (proven in TestCheckoutSession::test_checkout_session_success).
